name: last30days
description: Report what is genuinely new in the last 30 days on a topic, by slicing locally collected nightly channel databases with no live crawling. Run it before a strategic decision, as the fresh-signal feed for the gap phase. Triggers: "/last30days <topic>", "trendwatch <topic>", "what changed last 30 days on X".
